task: Self-hosted Vaultwarden (vault.grid7.com): create an organization with a collection for a second assistant (Jill), invite the assistant's account to it as a User with access to that collection only

steps.human: Sign in to your vault in this tab (master password + 2FA). Press Done when you see your vault.

steps.do: Look under Organizations / New organization. If an organization named in the chat already exists, report it and skip to collection.
Create the organization with the name and billing email Jax gives in the chat (free, self-hosted). Fill the form but do not submit.

steps.human: Check the organization form against the chat. Press Submit yourself, then Done.

steps.do: In the new organization, create the collection Jax names in the chat (e.g. Jill). Save it.
Members > Invite member: the assistant's email from the chat, role User, access to that one collection only (can view, no manage). Fill the form but do not send.

steps.human: Check the invite: role User, one collection only. Press Save yourself, then Done.

accept: The organization and collection exist, and the assistant's email shows as Invited with role User and access to that one collection.
notes: Creating the org and sending the invite are human steps.
Jax registers the assistant's own Vaultwarden account from its inbox outside this browser, then Sean confirms the member in a later session.
No save_secret step: nothing here creates a credential Jax needs to keep.
